answer.reason: Debir's story has two clear events: Joshua's destruction of it and Othniel's capture of it for Achsah as Caleb's offer.

clauses.english: was taken by Joshua, who destroyed its king and all its people
clauses.quote: he took it, and the king thereof

clauses.english: was taken by Othniel, who won Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife for it
clauses.quote: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it

doubts: Debir was also called Kirjathsepher and Kirjathsannah; the verses name it under these names too.
Debir appears in JOS 12:13 only as the king in a list, and in JOS 21:15 and 1CH 6:58 only as a priests' city in lists, so these were not used.
JOS 11:21 mentions Debir only as one place from which the Anakims were cut off, so it was not used.
